# Repository contribution instructions

## AgentOps documentation

- Place AgentOps documentation under the root `agentops/` directory.
- Write AgentOps field delivery guides as practical execution guidance, not as a
  Statement of Work, commercial scope, Definition of Use, or detailed product
  runbook.
- Cover both Microsoft Foundry agents and Microsoft Copilot Studio agents unless
  a document is explicitly and clearly platform-specific.
- Distinguish platform implementation paths. Use Foundry evaluation,
  observability, and deployment capabilities for Foundry agents, and use Copilot
  Studio evaluation, analytics, Monitor, and Power Platform ALM capabilities for
  Copilot Studio agents.
- Describe the AgentOps Accelerator as a Foundry-specific reference
  implementation. Do not imply that it supports or implements Copilot Studio.
- Ground product claims in current first-party Microsoft documentation and link
  the relevant sources.
- Keep customer-specific secrets, tenant identifiers, and production data out of
  documentation examples.
